card.name: Feeding tube and gastrostomy wording
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation marks right after 'through a', 'gastrostomy' or 'gastrostomy tube' in directions for giving drugs by feeding tube. Also the middle of 'percutaneous' in PEG-J descriptions.

modes.label: Linking word before a tube
modes.description: 'a' or 'or' that comes just before or between names of feeding tubes.
modes.example: or through<< a>> PEG-J for long-term administration.

modes.label: After gastrostomy tube name
modes.description: An opening bracket or comma after 'Gastrostomy Tube' or 'gastrostomy', before the abbreviation G-tube.

card.plain: It marks the spot in tube-feeding instructions where the next word will be another kind of tube or its abbreviation.
